summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Oddity Tech Ltd. furnishing a press release of Q1 2026 financial results. The filing discusses net revenue decline, adjusted EBITDA losses, and a CPA dislocation with a major advertising partner, along with remediation progress. It does not propose any structural corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private transaction, or capital return. The disclosure is a routine earnings update by a foreign private issuer, incorporated into an existing registration statement. Therefore, this filing is not a special situation.
